title: There are at least 60 Pizza Hut Classics (red roofs,...
content: There are at least 60 Pizza Hut Classics (red roofs, checkered tablecloths, salad bar) in the US…but the company does nothing to promote them. “They are like wormholes in the chain restaurant galaxy, portals to the past found by serendipity.”
author: Jason Kottke
